slides.heading: Chat to us first if you have

caption:
Koko's granddaughter suggested Pilates, but Koko worried she was too stiff. Good news: you don't need to be flexible to start, at 50 or at 70.

Clinical Pilates begins with an assessment, so exercises can be adapted around sore knees, backs or shoulders. Good programs go well beyond the core, with leg strength, balance and upper body work. Current guidelines recommend strength training for adults of all ages.

Once or twice a week is a good starting point, and consistency counts for more than intensity. Recent surgery, injury or dizziness? Tell us first.

Our Pilates team at Hybrid Physio works with plenty of first-timers. Book online via the link in bio 🐨

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
